I’m now tying that route change to the exact prior controller probes and diagnostic fields before choosing a single bounded mechanism.

The evidence supports a conservative candidate: adopt the exact duplicated speed-gated damping policy, without combining it with the separately successful bearing schedule or interpolating any static gain. Per the wake-visual-signals skill, I’m recording that diagnosis and falsification boundary before touching the solver policy.
